projects.title: H.Bloom Gift App
projects.description: The H.Bloom Gifts app for iPhone provides an intuitive, yet elegant high-end gift-giving experience for delivery in select cities. Using the app, users can easily send flowers, cupcakes, chocolates, candles, and French macaroons to friends, family, and business colleagues on the same day an order is placed. H.Bloom Gifts is available in the app store and can currently be used to purchase gifts for delivery in New York City, San Francisco, Washington D.C., Chicago and Dallas with more cities available in the future.
